Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

A playful, joyful, two-color risograph print aesthetic uses one warm off-white
paper surface across every section. Fluorescent brand pink is the only
interaction driver. A deep federal-blue secondary carries every heading and the
signature offset print-shadow.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: clean, high-contrast
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Space Grotesk,
  display=Space Grotesk, mono=Overpass Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500,
  600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary | Tokens: primary=#F237A1,
  secondary=#2C40A7, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Playful two-color risograph-inspired system with paper-like warmth, vivid pink
actions, and bold blue structure.
